title: Thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe thanks Sheller and they end the recording.

blocks.x: Well said. And on that note I’m going to thank you again for your time and congratulate you on your career again. You’re one of those people sort of on both sides of the glass, and sometimes the real architect behind the sounds. So thank you for that.
